description: This file contains a unit test class 'WorkScheduleServiceTest' for testing the 'WorkScheduleService' in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It includes test methods that verify the behavior of retrieving and validating work schedule implementations, along with some mock classes for testing different scenarios.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClass
classes.description: Mock class representing an invalid work schedule class that does not implement the required interface.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClassExceptionInConstructor
classes.description: Mock class that throws an exception when instantiated, used for testing constructor failure handling.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleValidClass
classes.description: Mock implementation of 'WorkScheduleInterface' used for unit testing, providing minimal method implementations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with an instance of 'WorkScheduleService'.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleNotDefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when no work schedule implementation is returned by configuration (expected TypeError).

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when the specified work schedule class is not found, expecting a ConfigurationException.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests behavior when the implementation class does not implement the expected interface, expecting a ConfigurationException.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassExceptionInConstructor
methods.description: Tests behavior when the constructor of the work schedule class throws an exception, expecting a ConfigurationException.

methods.name: testGetWorkSchedule
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of a valid work schedule implementation.
